description:
VARRD's PREDICTION lane: Kalshi / Polymarket / sports markets, through the same engine and the same rules (K-tracking, no lookahead, one hypothesis at a time). PRICE: $1.00 per completed test (an event study or a retest that tests new holds); searching markets, loading data, building the signal and conversation are free; an identical retest is free.

MULTI-TURN: the first call creates a session; keep passing session_id. Flow: describe the signal in plain language -> 'test it' -> results (per-hold win rate, edge vs the market price, p-values) -> 'trade setup'. Say 'start a new hypothesis' between ideas.
Read `state` and `next_steps` every call; `widgets` carry the tables the result is made of.

league_hint.description: Optional league hint for ambiguous team names: NFL, NBA, CFB, MLB, NHL.

message.description: Your prediction-market idea, question, or instruction ('test it', 'trade setup').

session_id.description: Session id from a previous call. Omit to start a new session.

name: prediction_ai

next_steps.description: What the user can ask for next

state.description: Where the flow is: scope, signal built, tested, ...

widgets.description: Result tables (event study, retest, trade setup)
